from datetime import datetime, timezone


def _sort_key(value):
    """Turn updated_at into a comparable datetime.

    Accepts datetime objects, ISO 8601 strings (including a trailing 'Z'),
    or Unix timestamps (int/float). Naive datetimes are treated as UTC so
    naive and timezone-aware values can be compared safely.
    """
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value
    elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=timezone.utc)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        if text.endswith(("Z", "z")):
            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    else:
        raise TypeError(f"Unsupported updated_at value: {value!r}")

    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt


def merge_attendance(records):
    """Keep one record per (player, date): the most recently updated one.

    If two records for the same player and date have the same updated_at,
    the one appearing later in the input wins, since a later upload is the
    more likely retry or correction. Output keeps the order in which each
    (player, date) pair first appears in the input.
    """
    kept = {}  # (player, date) -> (timestamp, record)

    for record in records:
        key = (record["player"], record["date"])
        stamp = _sort_key(record["updated_at"])
        current = kept.get(key)
        if current is None or stamp >= current[0]:
            kept[key] = (stamp, record)

    return [record for _, record in kept.values()]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sample = [
        {"player": "Ana", "date": "2026-11-01", "status": "absent",  "updated_at": "2026-11-01T18:00:00Z"},
        {"player": "Ana", "date": "2026-11-01", "status": "present", "updated_at": "2026-11-01T18:05:00Z"},
        {"player": "Ana", "date": "2026-11-01", "status": "present", "updated_at": "2026-11-01T18:05:00Z"},  # retry
        {"player": "Ben", "date": "2026-11-01", "status": "late",    "updated_at": "2026-11-01T17:59:00+00:00"},
        {"player": "Ana", "date": "2026-11-08", "status": "present", "updated_at": "2026-11-08T18:00:00Z"},
        {"player": "Ben", "date": "2026-11-01", "status": "present", "updated_at": "2026-11-01T17:30:00Z"},  # older, dropped
    ]
    for r in merge_attendance(sample):
        print(r)
